About.title: A place where you can let go
About.description: You are always there for someone: for work, for family, for everyone. Even after a good night's sleep you wake up drained, with tense shoulders, a headache and thoughts that won't stop circling. Here, you don't have to do anything. You can pause, feel warmth and safety, and finally let someone take care of you.

p1.title: Mindful touch
p1.description: No two days are the same, and no two bodies need the same thing. Sometimes it's about releasing tension you have carried for months. Sometimes it's simply about feeling safe. We start with how you feel today.

p2.title: Silence and breath
p2.description: No judgement and no rush. If you don't have the energy to talk, you don't have to say a word. You can close your eyes, breathe and, for the first time in a long while, stop being on guard.

p3.title: Care for you
p3.description: Every day, you are the one caring for others. Here the roles are reversed: you are surrounded by warmth, cleanliness, calm and attentive hands. You arrive carrying the weight of the day and leave lighter, feeling truly seen.

privacyContent.title: 1. Data Controller
privacyContent.text: The data controller is In Touch Massasjeterapi based in Drammen (Org. no.: 929 173 848). We process data in accordance with the Norwegian Personal Data Act (Personopplysningsloven) and GDPR.

privacyContent.title: 2. Purpose and legal basis for processing
privacyContent.text: Data is collected to manage bookings, provide therapeutic services, and meet legal requirements. The legal basis is the performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR).

privacyContent.title: 3. Data recipients
privacyContent.text: Data is securely stored with our certified booking system provider (Timma). We do not share data with third parties for marketing purposes without explicit consent.

privacyContent.title: 4. User rights
privacyContent.text: You have the right to access, correct, transfer, or delete your data. To exercise these rights, contact us at intouch.massasje@gmail.com.

termsContent.title: 1. Bookings and cancellations
termsContent.text: Free cancellation or rescheduling of an appointment is possible up to 24 hours before the scheduled time. In case of late cancellation or no-show, the client will be charged 100% of the treatment price.[cite: 1]

termsContent.title: 2. Health information
termsContent.text: Before starting the treatment, the client is obliged to inform the therapist of any illnesses, allergies, previous surgeries, or pregnancy. Treatments are performed at the client's own risk if they conceal significant health information.[cite: 1]

termsContent.title: 3. Payments
termsContent.text: We accept payments after the visit via payment cards, the Vipps app, and cash.[cite: 1]

termsContent.title: 4. Consumer disputes
termsContent.text: All complaints are handled in accordance with the Norwegian Consumer Purchases Act (Forbrukerkjøpsloven). In the event of disputes, the client may contact the Forbrukerrådet.[cite: 1]

termsContent.title: 5. Minimum age
termsContent.text: Our services are available to individuals who are at least 16 years old. Minors aged 16–18 may receive a treatment only with the written consent of a parent or legal guardian.[cite: 1]

termsContent.title: 6. Contraindications and cancellation of treatment
termsContent.text: The therapist has the right to refuse or interrupt a treatment if the client exhibits health contraindications (e.g., fever, infectious disease, skin inflammation, fresh injuries) that threaten the safety of the client or the therapist. In such cases, the client will not be charged the full cost of the treatment, unless the contraindication resulted from concealing health information.[cite: 1]

termsContent.title: 7. Pregnancy massage
termsContent.text: Pregnancy massage is performed only between the 14th and 35th week of pregnancy. Outside this period, the treatment is not performed for safety reasons.[cite: 1]

termsContent.title: 8. Behavior towards the therapist
termsContent.text: Any behavior violating the therapist's privacy, dignity, or comfort (including sexual behavior, inappropriate comments, or physical contact beyond the scope of the treatment) will result in immediate termination of the visit without the right to a refund and may lead to a refusal of future service.[cite: 1]

termsContent.title: 9. Vouchers
termsContent.text: Gift vouchers (gavekort) are valid for 6 months from the date of purchase and are non-extendable and non-refundable for cash. The voucher's expiration date is visible on the purchase receipt sent to the client.[cite: 1]

termsContent.title: 10. Personal data (Privacy)
termsContent.text: The client's personal and health data are processed solely to provide the service and in accordance with applicable data protection laws (Personopplysningsloven/GDPR). Data is not shared with third parties without the client's consent.[cite: 1]

termsContent.title: 11. Lateness
termsContent.text: A client's lateness shortens the duration of the treatment without a price reduction. For delays exceeding 15 minutes, the studio reserves the right to refuse the treatment, treating it as a no-show (see point 1).[cite: 1]

termsContent.title: 12. Hygiene and client's condition
termsContent.text: Treatments are not performed on clients under the visible influence of alcohol or other intoxicating substances, nor in the presence of visible signs of an infectious disease.[cite: 1]

termsContent.title: 13. Personal belongings
termsContent.text: The studio is not responsible for the client's personal belongings left unattended during the visit.[cite: 1]

termsContent.title: 14. Changes to the terms and conditions
termsContent.text: The studio reserves the right to amend these terms and conditions. The current version is always available in the app/on the studio's website.[cite: 1]

termsContent.title: 15. Force majeure
termsContent.text: The studio is not responsible for the cancellation or rescheduling of an appointment due to circumstances beyond its control (therapist's illness, breakdown, weather conditions preventing travel).[cite: 1]

termsContent.title: 16. Photos and social media
termsContent.text: The studio may take photos of the premises/products for promotional purposes. Photos of the client are taken only with their explicit consent.[cite: 1]

termsContent.title: 17. Right to refuse service
termsContent.text: The studio reserves the right to refuse service in the event of aggressive, disrespectful behavior by the client or a violation of these terms, regardless of the reason described in point 8.[cite: 1]

OfferPage.title: Our treatments
OfferPage.intro: Do you feel your body is carrying more than it should? With me, you can finally let your shoulders drop. With over 14 years of experience, my hands listen to your body, and every massage is tailored to you and how you feel that day. A calm, warm spa atmosphere where nothing is rushed, with therapeutic depth you can truly feel. First time? Choose START HERE. You are in good hands.

start-deep-unwind.name: Start here – Deep unwind
start-deep-unwind.description: First time with me, and want the full experience? We begin with a calm conversation about your body, your health history and what you would like help with. Then you get 75 minutes of full body, face and scalp massage, in a warm atmosphere with a real spa feel and no rush. The consultation is extra, so you don't lose any time on the table. You leave deeply relaxed, with a clear plan ahead.

start-here.name: Start here
start-here.description: First time with me? Start here. We begin with a calm conversation about your body, your health history and what you would like help with. Then you get a 50-minute full-body massage, where I feel for where the tension really sits – often somewhere other than where it hurts. The consultation is extra, so you don't lose any time on the table. A calm, warm atmosphere with a real spa feel lets you relax from the very first moment. You leave with a lighter body and a clear plan ahead.

deep-unwind.name: Deep unwind
deep-unwind.description: My recommendation – and the treatment chosen most often. A true spa experience, with the depth of a therapeutic massage. In 75 minutes I have time to work thoroughly with your whole body while giving your face and scalp the time they deserve. I follow your body and stay where it asks me to, at a calm pace with no rush. The session ends with a scalp massage, and many say it's hard to get up from the table afterwards.

total-immersion.name: Total immersion
total-immersion.area: Full body, face and head · Cupping included
total-immersion.description: My most luxurious treatment – a whole spa session for you who want to give your body full attention. You get the whole body, face and head, with time to work thoroughly and intuitively with everything that needs it. Cupping is included wherever your body needs it. Ideal after a demanding period, or as a gift to yourself.

tailored.name: Tailored
tailored.description: No two massages with me are the same, but the calm and the spa feel are always there. I read your body as I work and combine classic massage, deep tissue and trigger point work based on what you need that particular day. Want your face and scalp too, and more time where your body needs it? Choose Deep unwind 75 min.

drop-shoulders.name: Let your shoulders drop
drop-shoulders.description: For you who sit a lot, carry stress in your shoulders or feel stiffness in your neck. 50 minutes of full focus where the tension sits, with deep tissue, trigger points and stretching, and pressure adjusted to what you like. Tension in several places? Choose Deep unwind 75 min.

quiet-mind.name: Quiet mind
quiet-mind.description: A deeply calming treatment for the face, jaw, head, neck and shoulders. Well suited if you experience tension headaches, a tight jaw or teeth grinding, or simply need to quiet a busy mind. Want to combine this with the full body? Choose Deep unwind 75 min.

focus.name: Focus
focus.description: For you who have little time but plenty of tension. I work purposefully on the neck, shoulders and upper back, with deep tissue, trigger points and stretching where your body needs it. Perfect as maintenance between longer treatments.

pregnancy-deep-unwind.name: Pregnancy deep unwind
pregnancy-deep-unwind.area: Full body, face and head · Weeks 13–35
pregnancy-deep-unwind.description: The full spa experience for you who are expecting. You lie safely and comfortably on a specially designed pregnancy pillow, and I adapt pressure and positions to your body and your pregnancy. In 75 minutes we cover the whole body at a calm pace, with a gentle foot massage for heavy legs, and the session ends with a face and scalp massage. A long, calm moment just for you, at a time when your body works hard every day.

pregnancy.name: Pregnancy massage
pregnancy.description: A safe and calm massage for you who are expecting. You lie comfortably on a specially designed pregnancy pillow, and I adapt pressure and positions to your body and your pregnancy. The treatment is made for tense backs and heavy legs, and gives you a calm spa moment just for yourself. Tip: add a foot massage for extra light legs.

FaqPage.title: FAQ
FaqPage.subtitle: Frequently Asked Questions
FaqPage.contactPrompt: Have other questions or concerns before your appointment? Feel free to contact me.

faqs.question: How to choose the right massage?
faqs.answer:
Choose the duration of the massage you feel like having. If this is your first time with me, I especially encourage you to book the 60 min full body massage.
Before every massage, I will conduct a short interview with you. You will tell me about your needs, tensions, and what matters most to you.
You don't have to know exactly what your body needs — that's what I'm here for.

faqs.question: How can I book an appointment?
faqs.answer:
Booking an appointment is very simple. You will find the booking link directly on the homepage.
Select the massage you are interested in, the duration of the treatment, and a convenient date — and you're done.
I do not accept bookings by phone or text message. All appointments are booked online.

faqs.question: Can I contact you by phone?
faqs.answer:
I usually have my hands full while working with clients, which is why I can't always answer the phone.
In emergency situations, if I have the opportunity, I can quickly reply to a text message.
If you have questions, want to learn more about the massage, or need help before your appointment, please use the contact form available on the website.
This allows me to calmly focus on the person currently on the table.

faqs.question: How to prepare for a massage?
faqs.answer:
To make the massage as comfortable as possible for you:

• Do not eat about 1.5–2 hours before the massage.
• If you are coming directly after a workout, please take a shower. Hygiene is very important to me.
• Do not smoke cigarettes immediately before the massage.
• Do not drink alcohol before the massage.
• Remove all jewelry — preferably leave it at home or keep it safely in your bag.
• Plan your visit so you don't rush straight from work.
• If you have an injury, health condition, take medications, or if anything happened that might matter for the massage — inform me before we start.

Come calmly, fresh after a shower, and give yourself a moment to breathe. I'll take care of the rest.

faqs.question: Do I need to prepare in any special way regarding body hair?
faqs.answer:
You do not need to wax or shave before the massage.
Gentlemen, if your body hair is very dense, I only ask for a gentle trim rather than complete removal. Shorter hair will make my work easier and the massage more comfortable.
Ladies do not need to shave their legs before the visit. You don't need to apologize for it or feel embarrassed.
And most importantly — do not apologize for how your body looks.
I am not here to judge you. I have seen thousands of human bodies — each different, each unique.
This place is for you to put down self-judgment for a moment, feel safe, and simply embrace yourself.
And I will help you with that.

faqs.question: Do I need to undress for the massage?
faqs.answer:
Gentlemen are asked to remain in their underwear, while ladies may remain in their underwear bottoms.
Your body is securely covered and draped. Only the specific part of the body I am currently working on is uncovered.
Your sense of security and comfort are most important to me.

faqs.question: Does the massage hurt?
faqs.answer:
The massage can be intense, especially when we work with heavily tense areas, but the pain should be pleasant, relaxing, and bring a sense of relief.
During the massage, we stay in constant contact. I listen to your body, observe its reactions, and adjust the intensity to your needs.
If anything is too strong or uncomfortable — let me know.

faqs.question: Can I ask for a stronger or gentler massage?
faqs.answer:
Of course.
The intensity of the massage can always be adjusted to your preferences and current well-being.
There is no single correct intensity for everyone. What is the ideal pressure for one person might be too strong for another.
That is why I listen to you and your body throughout the entire treatment.

faqs.question: Can I point out a specific area you should focus on?
faqs.answer:
Yes. If your neck, back, shoulders, legs, hips, or any other part of the body is bothering you the most — tell me about it during the interview.
The massage time is limited, so we will set priorities together to make the best use of the time allocated for your treatment.

faqs.question: Do I have to talk during the massage?
faqs.answer:
Absolutely not.
You can talk to me if you feel like it, but you can also completely quiet down.
I do not expect conversation. You can simply close your eyes, breathe, and rest.
This is your time.

faqs.question: Can I fall asleep during the massage?
faqs.answer:
Of course!
If your body and nervous system finally let go enough for you to fall asleep — allow yourself to do so.
For me, this is a sign that you have managed to truly disconnect from everyday life and enter a state of deep relaxation.

faqs.question: Is the massage suitable for people who have never had a massage before?
faqs.answer:
Most definitely!
If this is your first time, let me know. I will explain everything thoroughly and make sure you know what to expect.
You don't have to stress about anything — I will guide you through the entire treatment.

faqs.question: Do you perform massages for pregnant women?
faqs.answer:
Yes! I have a special, comfortable pregnancy pillow and a dedicated massage available in the booking system.
If you have no contraindications and are between the 13th and 35th week of pregnancy, you are welcome.
The first trimester and the final stage of pregnancy require special caution, which is why massages during these periods are not performed here for safety reasons.
If in doubt, consult your doctor or midwife about the possibility of a massage.

faqs.question: Can I get a massage during menstruation?
faqs.answer:
Yes. Menstruation in itself is not a contraindication to massage.
It all depends on how you feel.
If you suffer from severe menstrual pain or take painkillers, your perception of stimuli may be altered.
Inform me about it, and I will keep it in mind during the massage.

faqs.question: Can I come for a massage if I am sick?
faqs.answer:
If you have a runny nose, a sore throat, a cough, a fever, or other signs of illness — stay home and reschedule your appointment.
My work involves direct contact with people. If you infect me, I will have to cancel subsequent appointments.
As a small business owner, I really don't have time for that.
If you feel something is coming on, write to me and we will reschedule the visit.

faqs.question: I have other health issues. Can I get a massage?
faqs.answer:
If you have health issues, an injury, had surgery, take medications, or have any doubts — write to me before your appointment.
Inform me of anything that might matter for the massage, and I will explain precisely how we can approach the treatment.
If you are unsure — it's always better to ask.

faqs.question: What to do after a massage?
faqs.answer:
After the massage, give yourself time to rest.
Have a warm cup of tea, stay hydrated, and plan the rest of your day without major obligations.
Read a book, get under a blanket, unwind, and ideally go to sleep early.
If possible, avoid intense workouts and heavy exertion immediately after the massage.
Slow down. Breathe. Let your body do the rest.

faqs.question: Can my muscles be sore after a massage?
faqs.answer:
After a more intense massage, temporary muscle tenderness or a feeling similar to post-workout soreness may occur.
However, if sharp, unusual pain appears or something worries you — contact me.

faqs.question: How often is it worth getting a massage?
faqs.answer:
A massage is always a good idea.
The more often you give yourself a moment of mindfulness, pausing, and true relaxation, the better for your nervous system.
You don't have to wait until the tension becomes unbearable.
My minimum for everyone? Massage 1x a month.
Treat it not as a luxury, but as a regular form of self-care.

faqs.question: Can I buy a massage voucher?
faqs.answer:
Of course!
You can purchase a voucher through the form on the website.
You can pick it up elegantly packaged at the studio or — if you cannot pick it up in person — I can send you a specially generated link for the recipient.
It is always a unique gift — giving someone care, attention, and time just for themselves.

faqs.question: Can I cancel or reschedule an appointment?
faqs.answer:
Yes. You can do this yourself using the link found in the booking confirmation.
Cancellation or changing an appointment is possible up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.
Your slot is reserved exclusively for you. Advance notice gives me the opportunity to offer it to someone else.
In case of cancellation later than 24 hours before the appointment or failure to show up, the visit is fully payable and an invoice will be issued.
Please — respect my time just as I respect yours.

faqs.question: What if I am late for my appointment?
faqs.answer:
Each appointment is scheduled for a specific time, and another client may be waiting after you.
Therefore, I do not extend the massage by the time you are late — out of respect for subsequent clients and their reserved time.
If you know you will be late, please send a short text message.
Punctuality allows me to provide every client with a calm and professional visit.

AboutPage.title: About me
AboutPage.lead: For more than 15 years I have worked with the human body. In that time I have learned that the body can say far more than we are able to put into words.
AboutPage.clients: My clients come back and recommend me to their loved ones.
storyIntro: Tense shoulders, a clenched jaw, shallow breathing, fatigue or pain are often traces of what is happening in our lives: stress, emotions, exhaustion and a lack of rest. I know myself how easy it is to forget about your own body when you have so much on your mind every day.

quote.text: That is why, during a massage, I don't just see tense muscles.

story: I listen, observe and adapt my work to what you truly need. I want not only to bring you relief, but also to help you feel your body again, notice its signals and build a better connection with it.
I believe that sometimes what we need most is simply a place where we can stop rushing, put everything down for a while, take a deep breath and let someone take care of us.
That is exactly the kind of place I wanted to create at In Touch.
A place full of calm, mindfulness and respect. Without judgement and without rush – with professionalism, but also with empathy and simple, human understanding.
AboutPage.closing: Your body is not something to ignore. It is the home you live in every single day. I want to help you feel good in it.

events.title: Massage as part of exceptional experiences
paragraphs: Gatherings, conferences, yoga retreats or team events in a mountain cabin are occasions not only to meet and grow, but also to pause for a moment and take care of yourself.

I offer professional massage that lets participants relax their bodies, regain energy and find space for real rest. Massage becomes a valuable part of the programme, and the organiser can be confident that every detail has been carefully thought through.
I work with hotels, companies and event organisers, creating solutions tailored to the character of the event, the number of participants and the time available.
Have an idea for a joint project, or looking for a way to add a moment of recovery to your event? Write to me. I would love to hear your vision and prepare a proposal tailored to your needs.

If you are a massage therapist, physiotherapist or bodywork specialist and would like to bring your knowledge, experience and skills to In Touch, I would love to hear from you.
I am open to working with people who share my approach to bodywork, value an individual approach to every client and want to grow in an atmosphere of mutual respect and professionalism.
